title: Don't waste your money on a subscription
text:
Over time you will get duplicative products, more serums and sunscreens that any one person can use, and some you won't want to use after trying. Just a lot of junk and sample sizes. And as a redhead, the make up shades were often horrible for me. They just increase your carbon footprint and it's wasteful.

I received a response to a complaint and they said 90% of my annual subscription was already packaged. So in July their boxes through next April are already packaged. So it you think you are getting old stuff you are.
label: negative
